description: Grid-cell surface areas, Armenia is a dataset listed in Open Data Armenia, an open data portal (CKAN) run by a civil-society initiative, published or maintained by WorldPop. The dataset is available to download in Geotiff format at a resolution of 3 arc-second approximately 100m at the equator. The projection is Geographic Coordinate System, WGS84. The value of each grid cell represents its surface area (in square meters).Data Source: Population data sources (for the whole 2000-2020 period)Methodology: Methodology: Lloyd, C. T., H. Coverage: WorldPop. The publisher named on the listing is WorldPop. The listing shows 1 download or service links in GEOTIFF. The listing shows 2023-07-08 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support energy network and generation-capacity studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-opendata-am.
